CustomField.description: Colors the bid moved past without a Completed Date. "None" when nothing was skipped. Reportable and filterable.
CustomField.formula: IF(LEN(IF(AND(ISBLANK(Pink_Completed_Date__c), Color_Review_Stage_Order__c > 1), ", Pink", "") & IF(AND(ISBLANK(Red_Completed_Date__c), Color_Review_Stage_Order__c > 2), ", Red", "") & IF(AND(ISBLANK(Blue_Completed_Date__c), Color_Review_Stage_Order__c > 3), ", Blue", "") & IF(AND(ISBLANK(Gold_Completed_Date__c), Color_Review_Stage_Order__c > 4), ", Gold", "") & IF(AND(ISBLANK(Green_Completed_Date__c), Color_Review_Stage_Order__c > 5), ", Green", "")) = 0, "None", MID(IF(AND(ISBLANK(Pink_Completed_Date__c), Color_Review_Stage_Order__c > 1), ", Pink", "") & IF(AND(ISBLANK(Red_Completed_Date__c), Color_Review_Stage_Order__c > 2), ", Red", "") & IF(AND(ISBLANK(Blue_Completed_Date__c), Color_Review_Stage_Order__c > 3), ", Blue", "") & IF(AND(ISBLANK(Gold_Completed_Date__c), Color_Review_Stage_Order__c > 4), ", Gold", "") & IF(AND(ISBLANK(Green_Completed_Date__c), Color_Review_Stage_Order__c > 5), ", Green", ""), 3, 60))
CustomField.label: Skipped Colors
